messages:
noah: Hey! First day and I think I'm mostly provisioned but two things: I can sign into Okta, but my Gmail alias (noah.sv@redwood.com) isn't available yet, and the 1Password invite link I got says 'account not found'. Who should I ping to sync the Google alias / 1P seat?

oliver: welcome!! :tada: ping @it (but also dropping in here). Can you paste the Okta username you see and the email on the 1P invite? sometimes alias vs primary email mismatch.

noah: Okta shows username = noah@redwood.ai, invite went to noah.sv@redwood.com. I attached a screenshot of the 1P error (says "no account for that email"). Not sure which one is canonical.

it-support-bot: Ticket created: IT-6732 - "Newhire alias / 1Password mismatch". Assigned to sam_itsupport. https://its.redwood.ai/ticket/IT-6732 :ticket:

sam: Hi Noah — sorry about that, congrats on the role! Looks like your Okta profile was created in the "contractor" org unit by automated sync which doesn't have the GSuite alias template. I've updated your org unit to "employees" and forced a directory sync. I also resent the 1Password seat to noah@redwood.ai (your Okta primary). Can you try these two things: 1) sign out of Gmail and clear cached accounts in Chrome, 2) open the new 1P invite link I just posted in the ticket. If you still need the alias noah.sv@redwood.com specifically, tell me and I'll add it as an alternate email.

noah: Tried the 1P link and it worked! Able to sign in and created my vault. Gmail alias still pending but I can access Drive with primary email. Thanks Sam :pray:

oliver: awesome. quick FYI — enroll in Okta Verify + add a second factor (we use passkeys or Yubi too). Onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboard/sso-mfa has all the steps. If you want me to add the noah.sv alias to your account for external email receipts, @sam can do that too.

sam: I can add that alias on request, but note alias adds a propagation delay ~5-15m across GSuite. Leaving ticket open until Noah confirms alias is visible.

noah: Seeing alias now, everything looks good. Closing out for me. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
